name: Anxi
description: Jewellery brand built around an anxiety ring, selling intentional, meaning-led rings direct through its own website, with a creator ambassador program run from its own ambassador site.

evidence.summary: Anxi's own ambassador page offers a flat 20% commission on every sale made with an ambassador's unique discount code, paid monthly, with a real-time dashboard, early access to drops and ambassador perks; applications are taken on the page and follower count is explicitly not a criterion.
The page states 'No caps. No tiers. Just a flat 20% from day one' and 'No minimums, no caps', so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped on the brand's own wording.

The program is a curated creator community; ambassadors can also refer other creators and earn on their sales, a single-level referral feature documented here for transparency. No fetched source publishes absolute creator counts, so creator_saturation is unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Jewellery is a highly visual, try-on friendly fashion niche and the brand is built around creator storytelling.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated ambassador site recruiting creators, with a dashboard, early access and a creator community.
reasons.compensation: Flat 20% from day one with an explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own page — top band.
reasons.contact_access: Open application on the brand's own ambassador page; no public email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application-based and curated, but follower count is explicitly not a criterion.
reasons.credibility: Small direct-to-consumer brand with its own store and a named co-founder quoted on the program page.

name: Corner of Main
